slides.title: ChatGPT now answers with charts, forms and buttons.
slides.sub: Intelligent UI in GPT-6: here's who gets it.
slides.voiceover: ChatGPT just stopped giving you walls of text. It now answers with charts and buttons.

slides.label: What's new
slides.title: Intelligent UI: answers you can tap
slides.sub: GPT-6 composes text, visuals and interactive elements based on your question.
slides.voiceover: It's called Intelligent UI. ChatGPT picks text, visuals or interactive elements to fit your question.

slides.label: What you can get
slides.title: Inside one answer
items: See the numbers, not a paragraph
Fill in details right in the chat
Interactive tools you use in the conversation
slides.voiceover: Answers can include graphics, charts, forms and tappable buttons, right inside the chat.

slides.label: Who gets it
slides.title: Two models, every plan
slides.voiceover: Paid plans run on GPT-6 Sol. Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna, rolling out now.

slides.label: Try 1
slides.name: Chart it
slides.prompt: Compare [TOPIC A] and [TOPIC B] and show it as a chart I can explore, not a paragraph.
slides.voiceover: Ask it to show a comparison as a chart, and watch what comes back.

slides.label: Try 2
slides.name: Make a form
slides.prompt: Build me a quick form to plan [TRIP / BUDGET / WORKOUT] and calculate the result when I fill it in.
slides.note: A tool made on the spot.
slides.voiceover: Or ask for a quick form that does the math for you.

slides.label: Try 3
slides.name: Explore a diagram
slides.prompt: Explain how [COMPLEX TOPIC] works as an interactive diagram I can click through step by step.
slides.voiceover: Learning something hard? Ask for a diagram you can click through.

slides.label: Try 4
slides.name: Give me buttons
slides.prompt: Help me decide on [CHOICE]. Give me tappable options and update the answer as I pick.
slides.voiceover: Stuck on a decision? Ask for tappable options.

slides.title: Stop reading walls of text.
lines: VISUAL for all of them, copy-ready
slides.voiceover: Try these four prompts, and comment visual to get them all.
